description: One perp market right now, venue by venue: price and premium to the index or stock, open interest, funding, max leverage, liquidation levels, whale trades, positioning; a stock perp's weekend move. Use when the user asks: X funding rate; where do X longs get liquidated. Not for: trends or book depth → get_perps_history. Args: entity.

entity.description: The market: a ticker or symbol (NVDA, BTC, XAU), a company name (Tesla) or a common asset name (bitcoin, gold, crude oil).
